test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following scheme was launched in April 2020 to enable an integrated property validation solution for rural India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**SVAMITVA**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The SVAMITVA scheme stands for **Survey of Villages and Mapping with Improvised Technology in Village Areas**.
 
• It was **launched by Prime Minister Narendra Modi** on National Panchayati Raj Day, April 24, 2020.
 
• The scheme aims to provide an integrated property validation solution for rural India through **drone technology and the latest survey methods**.
 
• Under this scheme, property cards are issued to the property owners, enabling them to use their property as a financial asset for loans and other financial benefits.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **SAMARTH**

 
 
• SAMARTH (Scheme for Capacity Building in Textile Sector) was launched by the Ministry of Textiles to address the skill gap in the textile sector.
 
• It aims to provide skill development and training to workers to enhance their employability in the textile industry.
 
 
 
• **UMANG**
 
 
• UMANG (Unified Mobile Application for New-age Governance) is a mobile app developed by the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) and the National e-Governance Division (NeGD).
 
• It provides access to a wide range of government services from various departments and states on a single platform.
 
 
 
• **KUSUM**
 
 
• KUSUM (Kisan Urja Suraksha evam Utthaan Mahabhiyan) is a scheme launched by the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE) to promote the use of solar energy among farmers.
 
• The scheme aims to provide financial and technical assistance to farmers for the installation of solar pumps and grid-connected solar power plants.
